name: gelu_tanh_and_mul
description: Fused gated tanh-approximated GELU. For input [...,2*d], computes 0.5*x1*(1+tanh(sqrt(2/pi)*(x1+0.044715*x1^3)))*x3 in float32 and casts back, where x1=input[...,:d] and x3=input[...,d:]. The Triton candidate makes non-contiguous inputs contiguous and supports leading dimensions. Returns a new [...,d] tensor. Current tests exercise bfloat16 2-D inputs; no mutation.
